title: Air temperature near the ground (NASA MERRA-2)
title_hi: ज़मीन के पास हवा का तापमान (NASA MERRA-2)
mission: NASA GMAO MERRA-2 reanalysis (M2TMNXSLV, monthly means of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct)
citation: Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO), 2015: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: 2d, Monthly mean, Single-Level, Assimilation, Single-Level Diagnostics V5.12.4. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/AP1B0BA5PD2K ; Gelaro, R. et al., 2017, J. Climate 30, 5419-5454.
explain: Air temperature 2 m above the ground from NASA's weather-history model, which blends satellite and ground data.
explain_hi: ज़मीन से 2 मीटर ऊपर हवा का तापमान, NASA के मौसम-इतिहास मॉडल से, जो उपग्रह और ज़मीनी डेटा मिलाता है।

known_transitions.label: NOAA-15 AMSU data enter the model
known_transitions.label_hi: NOAA-15 AMSU डेटा मॉडल में जुड़ा
